text:
Olivia Park: Apollo Ops dropped an early alpha rack at our SF lab. Need to lock NDA/DPA for raw telemetry + confirm HSM key handling before we accept logs.
Diego Rivera: curious: do they want us to ship artifacts back or do presigned uploads only? any constraints on key escrow?
Olivia Park: Apollo prefers presigned PUT to our artifact bucket. For signing they asked if we can accept tokens derived from their HSM (PKCS#11) for request-level encryption. Legal flagged key escrow concerns.
Maya Chen: Legal: can't accept escrowed customer keys. We can accept attestations and an ephemeral upload token and require AES-256 server-side encryption with KMS-managed keys. Apollo must sign the DPA for telemetry retention (proposed 90d) and agree to no raw prompt sharing.
Diego Rivera: bench plan: 2x 30m steady runs (1k & 2k contexts), 10m cold-start sweep, and a 15m continuous tail-stability run. We'll capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, GPU power (1s), package temp (5s), and watchdog resets.
Olivia Park: Partner provided firmware sha256 list for 5 units; I'll upload CSV to drive and pin firmware image shas in run metadata.
Harper Liu: infra: we'll provide presigned POST for streaming multipart/form-data and a verification lambda to validate sha256 and manifest. example POST:
```bash
curl -F "file=@session.tgz.gz" -F "manifest=@manifest.json" "${PRESIGNED_POST_URL}"
```
benchbot: Reserved run slot — queue id 9981, window 2025-09-05 22:00-02:00 UTC. Artifacts bucket created: s3://rwd-apollo-alpha-9981 (retention 90d). :white_check_mark:
Diego Rivera: add a manifest schema v2 field 'firmware_sha' and 'kmod_list'. Also include 'ambient_celsius' sensor and 'chassis_id' tag.
Olivia Park: Apollo asked for an embargo until co-press sign-off. Marketing wants to hold off on any marketplace preview listing until after the canary runs and regression pass.
Maya Chen: I'll draft NDA/DPA with explicit telemetry redaction rules (no verbatim prompts, remove unit identifiers) and confirm HSM attestation flow. ETA EOD.
Harper Liu: I'll push the presigned POST + lambda in 6h and include example verification CLI. minimal verification snippet:
```py
# verify manifest sha
import hashlib
print(hashlib.sha256(open('session.tgz.gz','rb').read()).hexdigest())
```
Diego Rivera: also request Apollo to provide a small deterministic trace (seeded) for reproducibility and a random-sampled real workload. seeds must be checked into the bench repo.
Olivia Park: action items: 1) Maya finalize NDA/DPA (EOD) 2) Harper deploy presigned POST + verification (ETA 6h) 3) Diego publish run matrix + seeds (ETA EOD+1) 4) benchbot slot 9981 reserved. I'll coordinate a 20m post-NDA sync 2025-09-04 16:00 UTC.
Maya Chen: pinged Apollo legal. will update here when signed. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: FYI - lab temp forecast shows SF lab ambient ~20-24C during window. Recommend extra fans on blade-04.
Diego Rivera: noted. I'll add fan profiles and a forced-throttle test to the matrix.
Olivia Park: thanks team. I'll post final checklist and the drive link once NDA is in place.
